india.one_line: India issues AI data-sharing handbook and telecom AI policy while firms raise billions for Nvidia chips and drones

themes.title: AI firms secure massive funding
themes.text: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to purchase Nvidia Vera Rubin chips, while CapGrid raises ₹50 cr to develop drones and data‑centre components.

stories.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase
CapGrid raises ₹50 cr funding, valued at ₹430 cr to expand into drones and data centres

themes.title: Regulators issue AI governance guidelines
themes.text: MeitY publishes a DEPA handbook for trusted data sharing in AI training, and TRAI releases draft AI policy requiring board approval and incident reporting for telecom operators.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training
TRAI drafts AI policy framework requiring board approval and incident reporting for telecoms
